redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-geographic fixtures only.
Public official pages or documents used as pinned validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution rights.
A layer-specific Cadastre Committee release whose license, attribution, schema, coverage, validity, and reuse terms are pinned.
Licensed postal, address, cadastral, or registry data kept outside public artifacts unless contract review explicitly permits release.

sources.production_scope: Pinned permitted index results, official post-office directory, or contract release retaining postal-region or post-office class, locality, source edition, capture time, rights, and digest.
Pinned UPU addressing guide used for syntax, presentation, and code-component semantics only.

sources.provider: Cadastre Committee of the Republic of Armenia
sources.production_scope: Only layer-specific, provider-approved public address fields from a pinned service or release; rights, restrictions, rightsholders, and protected registry fields remain excluded.
Layer-specific permitted public fields and geometry only, pinned by object identifier, status, coverage, release, CRS, rights, and digest.

sources.provider: Cadastre Committee of the Republic of Armenia
sources.production_scope: Layer-by-layer review only; each artifact pins authority, access class, license or fee terms, service endpoint, schema, coverage, territorial policy and vintage, update date, CRS, and digest.

artifact_partitions.rule: HayPost evidence retains result, directory or product edition, postal-region or post-office class, locality, capture time, rights, and digest; contract rows never silently enter public artifacts.
Cadastre Committee address assertions retain official object and community-decision identity, hierarchy, status, coordinate provenance, service release, rights, and postal cross-check status.
Address and National Geoportal building identities remain distinct until a common official identifier or reviewed crosswalk proves the link.
Rights-cleared address membership may generate a versioned, uncertainty-bearing derived surface; method and boundary clips remain reproducible and the result is never official geometry.
Every layer retains coverage, boundary policy, and territorial vintage; no gap or disputed feature is assigned AM identity from nearest postal evidence.
Recipients, residents, owners, rightsholders, occupants, phones, credentials, title and restriction records, and protected registry attributes never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
